reasoning_traces.think:
The calibration pipeline begins with exporting settled picks containing CLV fields, followed by Shin de-vig to correct for market vigorish. A time-ordered hold-out split ensures no leakage during training. Centered Isotonic Regression (CIR) is preferred over PAVA because it maintains ranking integrity crucial for stake decisions. The calibrated probabilities are then used in Kelly-based sizing where edge shrinkage and correlation adjustments prevent overfitting. The CLV deflator gates stake application until enough settled picks provide stable estimates. This process avoids inversion of covariance matrices typical in Markowitz optimization, instead relying on empirical edge and volatility. The entire system is validated offline using synthetic datasets before deployment.
